The most spoken languages are Rajasthani languages such as Marwari in central and eastern regions, Sindhi in the southwest, and Lahnda in the northwest region of the Thar.  Majority of the people live in rural nomadic communities in the harsh environment of the Thar Desert.  People live in small huts which are shaped like a cylindrical bee hive topped by a conical thatched roof.
